name: @vaipakam/e2e-wallet
description: TEST-ONLY: the injected-wallet Playwright fixture the connected apps' e2e tiers share (apps/app/e2e, apps/alpha05/e2e). Injects an EIP-1193 + EIP-6963 provider into the page whose signing and RPC happen in the Playwright process via viem against a local Anvil, so the app sees an ordinary browser wallet and the ephemeral key never enters the page. Never imported by runtime code.
